Implement a binder abstraction layer to support pluggable binder types (U3) using Spring's configuration mechanisms.
Refactor the CC SPI deployer to integrate with CF Java client APIs (U5) while maintaining backward compatibility.
Leverage Maven profiles or externalized configuration (e.g., Spring Cloud Config) for override handling (U4).

Hadoop distribution libraries (U6) can be dynamically loaded via classpath isolation or plugin mechanisms.
Header-enricher module (U7) has minimal dependencies and can be moved without significant refactoring.
